policy: One shared GPU semantics implementation, not oracle modes. Canonical cases below are evidence links, not exception/waiver lists. Every reviewed input is identity/script/direction keyed and all six fields are checked; U rows still use live text-shaper. Report flags are conservative exposure evidence, not proof that each flagged primitive discriminates that input.
reviewedBy: Phase1 Tech Lead reviews and external coordinator-phase1-clearance.json; D10 option A user approval in goals.md

entries.referenceBehaviour: Legacy offsets are anchor-origin-relative and attached-chain geometry is wrong.
entries.liteBehaviour: Pen-relative attachment links, final root-relative propagation, and zero advances only for actually attached glyphs in every profile.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json)

entries.referenceBehaviour: UseMarkFilteringSet is not applied with its selected coverage.
entries.liteBehaviour: Filtering-set membership and lookup flags use shared skip semantics.

entries.referenceBehaviour: Pair placement/value2 fields and consuming format-2 continuation are incomplete.
entries.liteBehaviour: Both complete horizontal values and the correct continuation are executed.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json)

entries.referenceBehaviour: Nested actions are reduced to direct singles or rejected.
entries.liteBehaviour: Table-tagged nested actions use the matched sequence after each earlier action.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json)

entries.liteBehaviour: Every context input/backtrack/lookahead coverage is matched with shared predicates.
Contextual GPOS invokes the shared position actions at the matched position.

entries.referenceBehaviour: Skipped glyphs inside a consumed ligature span retain unrelated clusters.
entries.liteBehaviour: The full span merges to the minimum cluster, including skipped marks.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json) G0 proofs

entries.referenceBehaviour: Component selection and MarkMark component identity are incomplete.
entries.liteBehaviour: Ligature identities/components propagate; no matching ligature ID selects the last component. Contour anchors still reject when actually selected.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json)

entries.referenceBehaviour: The legacy Arabic joining pass misassigns isolated/final/medial/initial forms.
entries.liteBehaviour: GPU chunk-carry joining from pinned Unicode16 properties; one-hot masks and Arabic feature stages in the same lookup family.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json)

entries.referenceBehaviour: The unsorted stacked Arabic marks have a real MarkMark geometry defect, not a different representation.
entries.liteBehaviour: GPU bounded modified-CCC/MCM stable ordering and span cluster merges before lookups. Runs over 32 marks remain unchanged per the approved cap.

entries.reason: HarfBuzz GDEF-wide mark advance zeroing is not the approved product contract.
entries.referenceBehaviour: HB may zero a nonzero hmtx advance for an unattached class-3 glyph.
entries.liteBehaviour: N-proof/G0 use the font-table derivations and A-attach uses old independent records plus widths/pen-relative transforms. Every field remains exact; no general class-3 exemption.
evidence: existing-impact-report.json (diagnostic, not committed; identity in reference-identity.json): exactly 3 N-proof, 3 G0, 3 A-attach rows

entries.reason: D10 option A: first-increment GPU support boundary, not a claim that other fonts are invalid.
entries.referenceBehaviour: Other shapers can use presentation-form or AAT fallback.
entries.liteBehaviour: After nominal mapping, reject Arabic plans without selected joining features. Preserve unmapped error precedence and suppress all publication. No presentation-form/AAT fallback.

publicCoverage.scope: public exact mark attachment; all six fields use the cleared H record

public full pair values, including Hebrew placement; exact H record
public nested ligature, root 6/rule 0, exact cleared positive; also A⃝ root 9/rule 0 and <- root 48/rule 2
public format-3 context, co-exercised with C4; not an isolated primitive
No public real-font positive claimed. Internal PUA c6-context-pos is exact primitive evidence.
The public Inter nested ligatures exercise ordinary span merges. The discriminating skipped-mark span is internal c7-ligature-across-mark; G0 long-run records are exact.

No isolated public real-font component claim. Actual Arabic records traverse the shared attachment machinery, but component discrimination remains internal c8 witnesses and the cleared non-PUA legacy mark-ligature rows.

limits: The 11 PUA primitive witnesses execute internal GPU semantics; public admission is deliberately unchanged.
Inter root 48/rule 3 has no admitted cmap context. No font or admission mutation is used to claim it as public coverage.
RTL/Arabic uses the proven whole-run path; CTF-14 tracks RTL segmentation/stitch proof. Structural executor eligibility is not a speed claim.
No residual X treatment or unchecked-field exemption exists.
